metadata.description: GTM strategy skills for IT agencies — a 13-step cold-audit flow plus a standalone 23-criteria GTM audit; outputs a full go-to-market strategy and a 30-90-180 action plan to Notion; plus research, forecasting, growth and hiring skills and 3 planning tools.

plugins.name: gtm-strategy
plugins.description: Cold-audit GTM strategy flow for IT agencies: from a website URL to stage diagnosis, ICP, competitor gap, positioning, value prop, offers, buyer journey, materials and channels, and a 30-90-180 action plan, with a standalone 23-criteria GTM audit. Outputs to Notion in Ukrainian. Plus 8 research and planning skills (website scraper, competitor finder, market urgency, persona insights, idea stress test, revenue forecast, growth planner, hiring brief) and 3 planning tools (Anthropic, Apache-2.0).
